bio: With its discreet façade and small glass-paned front door, this restaurant is located in a cobbled pedestrian street in the city centre. The light-filled interior has sliding patio doors onto the street on one side and, on the other side, a pretty courtyard decorated with raised flowerbed boxes. A lot of preparation goes into the chef's array of modern dishes made with fresh local ingredients and presented in a series of indulgent courses....
